t: This is Alice Walker Close, a street in the London Borough of Lambeth. It takes its name from Alice Walker, the American novelist, poet and activist. In 1982 she became the first African-American woman to win the Pulitzer Prize for Fiction, for her novel The Color Purple. Over her career she has published seventeen novels and short story collections, twelve works of non-fiction, and collections of essays and poetry. So the name on the sign honours a writer whose work is read far beyond the street itself.
